caption: The drawing depicts a round, brown plate or dish with a decorative design in the center and writing around the rim. In the center of the plate, there are two stylized birds facing each other, both colored in shades of tan and yellowish-white, with greenish accents beneath their feet. Between the birds is a plant with a long, vertical stem and two rounded flowers or pods near the top, along with leafy branches and two smaller, flower-like shapes at the base. Surrounding the central motif is a circular, zig-zag border done in a lighter color. Along the outer edge of the plate, there is a ring of cursive writing done in a yellowish-white color. The plate is rendered against a plain, light beige background, and the artist’s signature and date are visible in the lower right area outside the plate.
title: Pa. German Dish
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
